description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing MCP (Managed Cloud Platform) servers, including CRUD operations, health checks, OAuth session handling, and public server management. It integrates with a database via Prisma, manages in-memory temporary server caching, and utilizes various internal modules for server management, authorization, and logging.

classes.name: _TemporaryMCPServerEntry
classes.description: Data class to represent a cached temporary MCP server along with its expiry time.

methods.name: None _prune_expired_temporary_mcp_servers()
methods.description: Removes expired temporary MCP server entries from in-memory cache.

methods.name: MCPServer _cache_temporary_mcp_server(server: MCPServer, ttl_seconds: int)
methods.description: Caches an MCP server in memory with a specified TTL (time-to-live).

methods.name: Optional[MCPServer] get_cached_temporary_mcp_server( server_id: str, )
methods.description: Retrieves a cached temporary MCP server by server ID if it exists and isn't expired.

methods.name: LiteLLM_MCPServerTable _redact_mcp_credentials( mcp_server: LiteLLM_MCPServerTable, )
methods.description: Returns a copy of an MCP server object with credentials removed for security.

methods.name: List[LiteLLM_MCPServerTable] _redact_mcp_credentials_list( mcp_servers: Iterable[LiteLLM_MCPServerTable], )
methods.description: Redacts credentials from a list of MCP server objects.

methods.name: NewMCPServerRequest _inherit_credentials_from_existing_server( payload: NewMCPServerRequest, )
methods.description: Inherits credentials from an existing server if the payload doesn't specify credentials.

methods.name: LiteLLM_MCPServerTable _build_temporary_mcp_server_record( payload: NewMCPServerRequest, created_by: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Creates an in-memory record for a temporary MCP server with a generated or provided server ID.

methods.name: get_prisma_client_or_throw(message: str)
methods.description: Retrieves Prisma client instance or throws an HTTP 500 error if not available.

methods.name: bool does_mcp_server_exist( mcp_server_records: Iterable[LiteLLM_MCPServerTable], mcp_server_id: str )
methods.description: Checks if an MCP server with a given ID exists within a list of server records.

methods.name: MCPServer _get_cached_temporary_mcp_server_or_404(server_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a temporary cached MCP server by server ID or raises a 404 error if not found.
